problem:
Compute the following determinant using a cofactor expansion along the $3$rd row:

$$
|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}|
$$

feedback.worked_solution:
Using a cofactor expansion along the $3$rd column, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & -1 & \sqrt{2} & 1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ -2 & 5 & \sqrt{3} & 1\end{aligned}| & =0\cdot {C}_{13}+\sqrt{2}\cdot {C}_{23}+0\cdot {C}_{33}+\sqrt{3}\cdot {C}_{43} \\  & =\sqrt{2}\cdot (-1)^{2+3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & -1 \\ -2 & 5 & 1\end{aligned}|+\sqrt{3}\cdot (-1)^{4+3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & -1 & 1 \\ -1 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =-\sqrt{2}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & -1 \\ -2 & 5 & 1\end{aligned}|-\sqrt{3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & -1 & 1 \\ -1 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
